rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
aura: No visible form or external manifestation is documented; c01/c02 describe internal illness, c07 a verbal banishment.
artistic_choices: Decline under GAMBAR6.5 without generation: a diseased ordinary human or an invented demon/medical cutaway would not depict a documented visible manifestation of Nežit. The great meadow c07 is the destination in a charm, not a form or physical power that can dominate the image.
reason: Riset lengkap tidak memuat rupa tubuh, ciri anatomi, atribut visual, atau manifestasi luar Nežit. c01/c02 menyebut roh masuk kepala/gigi dan menyebabkan sakit; c07 hanya perintah jampi agar keluar menuju padang. Gambar orang sakit akan menjadi manusia biasa, sedangkan tubuh iblis, asap, cahaya atau tangan gaib akan rekaan. Sesuai GAMBAR6.5, tidak digambar tanpa panggilan alat.
